ConnectionStrings.//: The control plane's OWN database — the tenant registry.

TenantDatabase.//: Admin connection to the MANAGED Postgres — used only to create and drop tenant databases and roles.
TenantDatabase.//TenantHost: Set when containers reach Postgres by a different name than the control plane does.

Mail.//: Where the invitation comes from. Disabled means tenants are created but nobody is invited.

Docker.//: Empty = the local daemon. Point at a socket proxy in production (ControlPlane.Deployment.md §12).
